headline: Marban Hollow and Olavis Wake Lead Widespread Base Exchanges
war_summary: Base contention surged sharply in Marban Hollow over the past two hours, recording seven strategic base transitions to spearhead the latest action across the front. Olavi's Wake and Weathered Expanse sustained their volatile pace, tallying five and four base exchanges respectively over the same span while soaking up thousands of casualties. Kuura Strand re-entered the transition ledger with two fresh turnovers in the latest two-hour window after earlier tapering, whereas structural changes in Linn of Mercy and Pari Peak cooled down considerably. Heavy bloodletting persists along unyielding lines elsewhere; Farranac Coast registered an accelerating casualty spike exceeding fifteen hundred combined losses across the past two hours without any shifts in base ownership, while Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands settled into a cooling pace of attritional fighting.
